fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,750. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0055268/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Passed SPM with Honors in Bahasa Malaysia; AND Passed STPM with a C (2.00 CGPA) in two (2) subjects; or a C in two (2) subjects including General Studies / General Paper and a D in two (2) other subjects; OR Passed STAM with Jayyid; OR Passed Basic Certificate / Foundation / Matriculation / Diploma in a related field with at least 2.00 CGPA from 4.00; OR Passed the MSU Diploma in Early Childhood Education with at least 2.00 CGPA; OR Passed A-Level with a Full Pass in three (3) subjects; OR Passed South Australian Matriculation (SAM) with a score of at least 65-70%; OR Passed Canadian Pre-University Program (CPU) with a score of at least 80%; OR Passed UEC with a B in five (5) subjects; OR Any other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
